items.title: Glorify God by Giving Thanks
items.summary: A life that gives glory to God for his grace and a life of deepest gladness are the same life. And what makes them one is thankfulness.

items.title: Hold Fast to Your Hope
items.summary: When Christ died for us, he did not buy the freedom from having to hold fast, but the enabling power to hold fast.

items.title: When God Swears by God
items.summary: It is as unlikely that God will break his word of promise to bless us as it is that he will despise himself.

items.title: The Key to Spiritual Maturity
items.summary: Getting ready to feast on all God’s word is not first an intellectual challenge; it is first a moral challenge.

items.title: The Gravity of Gratitude
items.summary: A thankful spirit is others-exalting and glad-hearted. Therefore, pray for a great awakening of humble gratitude.

items.title: Five Reasons Death Is Gain
items.summary: Death is gain because Christians will then be perfect, pain-free, rested, at home, and with Christ.

items.title: We All Need Help
items.summary: Because we have a Great High Priest, the throne of God is a throne of grace.

items.title: How to Beat Scrupulosity
items.summary: Scrupulosity questions whether we’ve done enough to please God. Pastor John offers a strategy for resisting intrusive thoughts and trusting Christ’s blood.

items.title: Are My Prayers Selfish?
items.summary: How do we know if we’re praying according to God’s will? Pastor John distinguishes unfaithful, selfish prayer from God-honoring, faithful prayer.

items.title: What We Get Wrong About the Tears of Jesus
items.summary: Was Jesus’s grief at Lazarus’s tomb over his friend’s death or the response of the mourners? Pastor John explains how Jesus’s perfect emotions captured his indignation over unbelief.

items.title: Scrolling the Soul Shallow
items.summary: Entertainment swamps nearly all of life in triviality. So, how can we resist the tide and embrace a wholehearted, soul-satisfying pursuit of God?

items.title: The Flavors of Holy Joy
items.summary: A well-cooked meal and a newborn baby fill our hearts with different delights. Pastor John explains how God’s gifts offer us a multicolored experience of joy.

items.title: How Evil Works
items.summary: How does Satan influence the world, and where do we see his work most clearly? Pastor John describes Satan’s power and limits under Christ’s victorious work.

items.title: Hospitality and God’s Grace
items.summary: Luke 14 is all about guests and hosts and parties. The Bible considers generosity to be radical, deeply unselfish living in every area of life. There are many kinds of currencies besides money. We come now to one that is underestimated in importance. It’s the area of hospitality. In three sections, Luke 14 shows us…

items.title: Generosity and Relationships
items.summary: There are people who relationally owe you. They owe you because of how they’ve treated you. You might demand something from them, or you might keep it inside and hold it against them. But that’s not being generous. Because to be generous means you release. It’s possible to be generous with your money and not at all…

items.title: Generosity and God’s Grace
items.summary: As soon as someone says “generosity,” you probably think money. But according to the Bible, generosity is more radical than money. The Bible teaches that generosity should be pervasive in all parts of our lives. Money is only part of it. It’s possible to be financially generous and not radically generous. Because…

items.title: I Am the I Am
items.summary: The more we hear about Jesus, the more we’re faced with an important question: who do we actually think Jesus is? Many of us tend to sit on the fence without choosing one side or the other—we may not want to declare that he really is the Son of God, but neither do we want to call him a liar. But Jesus himself says we…

items.title: I Am the Bread
items.summary: As human beings, each of us not only experiences physical hunger, but spiritual hunger deep inside us. And it isn’t long before we find that whatever we try to fulfill ourselves with, whether it’s family, acceptance, money, or comfort, is never going to satisfy us. Jesus knows this all too well—and gives us a much…

items.title: I Am the Vine
items.summary: This sermon was preached by Dr. Timothy Keller at Redeemer Presbyterian Church on December 6, 1998. Series: John – On Knowing the Christ. Scripture: John 10:1-17. Today's podcast is brought to you by Gospel in Life, the site for all sermons, books, study guides and resources from Timothy Keller and Redeemer…

items.title: Thanks in Everything
items.summary: Gratitude isn't pretending things are fine—it's lifting our eyes from the trouble to the One who reigns above it.

items.title: The True Cause for Hope
items.summary: Hope is the promise that suffering and evil will never get the last word.

items.title: Know in Whom You Believe
items.summary: Scripture is the living Word of God—and He wants to meet you there today.

items.title: God Is in Control
items.summary: Life's difficulties may catch us off guard, but there is nothing that surprises God and nothing He can't redeem.

items.title: Under Grace
items.summary: Sin no longer has a grip on us. We can live in the freedom of His grace today and forever.

items.title: Strengthened in the Lord
items.summary: Though discouragement may shake us, God's steady hand is always there to hold us.

items.title: In God’s Hand
items.summary: The assurance of our salvation isn't anchored in how convinced we feel. It's anchored in His testimony.

items.title: Stewarding Today’s Opportunities (Esther 4:14)
items.summary: In this episode of Pray the Word on Esther 4:14, David Platt calls us to steward the specific opportunities God has given us today. Explore more content from Radical.

items.title: Divine Sovereignty (Esther 1:12)
items.summary: In this episode of Pray the Word on Esther 1:12, David Platt reminds us that God works out every detail of the world for the good of those who trust him. Explore more content from Radical.

items.title: Faithful Servants (Nehemiah 13:31)
items.summary: In this episode of Pray the Word on Nehemiah 13.31, David Platt challenges us to serve God with eternity in view. Explore more content from Radical.

items.title: Rejoicing in Hope (Nehemiah 12:43)
items.summary: In this episode of Pray the Word on Nehemiah 12:43, David Platt asks God to help us rejoice, knowing that this world is not the end. Explore more content from Radical.

items.title: Joyful Obedience (Nehemiah 11:2)
items.summary: In this episode of Pray the Word on Nehemiah 11:2, David Platt asks God to help us be willing to do whatever he calls us to do. Explore more content from Radical.

items.title: Worthy of Our Best (Nehemiah 10:35)
items.summary: In this episode of Pray the Word on Nehemiah 10:35, David Platt teaches us to give the first of all our resources completely to God. Explore more content from Radical.

items.title: Immersed in the Word (Nehemiah 9:3)
items.summary: In this episode of Pray the Word on Nehemiah 9:3, David Platt encourages us to set apart significant periods of time to study Scripture. Explore more content from Radical.

items.title: God Doesn’t Need You
items.summary: Even on our strongest days, we depend on God for everything, yet He depends on nothing outside of Himself. In this episode, Costi Hinn explores three truths about God's self-sufficiency and how understanding this attribute should lead us to greater humility, gratitude, and trust in His gracious care.

items.title: Your Limits Are Not God's Limits
items.summary: Just because we cannot see a solution doesn't mean God lacks the power or resources to accomplish it. In this episode, Costi Hinn explores three truths about God's omnipotence and why we can trust His power even when His purposes are difficult to understand.

items.title: You Are Never Beyond the Reach of God
items.summary: There is nowhere you can go, nothing you can face, and no situation you can encounter where God is absent. His omnipresence is a source of comfort for believers, reminding us that we are never beyond His reach. In this episode, Costi Hinn explains how God's presence provides security and calls us to live with…

items.title: Nothing Is Hidden from God
items.summary: God doesn't just know about you. He knows you completely. His knowledge is perfect, personal, and without limitation. In this episode, Costi Hinn unpacks the omniscience of God and explains why being fully known by Him should change the way we live, pray, and respond to sin.

items.title: Nothing Happens Outside the Rule of God
items.summary: We often live as though everything depends on us, carrying the weight of circumstances we cannot control. In this episode, Costi Hinn explains how understanding the sovereignty of God changes the way we approach uncertainty, suffering, and our daily lives.
